previousContract.meaning: Preserves pinned destiny, auction, event, remaining-action and automatic transition fixtures; this version adds one-seat full-recall envelopes across current decision phases.

source.meaning: Frozen product source for adapter fixtures only; not a balance or release verdict.

scope.history: Append one seat's event, mark, sacrifice, auction and shrine-pick projected observations with that seat's own action; stable key includes the ordered history and current projected observation.
scope.trustBoundary: Accept only deeply immutable phase-specific observation projections with the current known schema; reject raw engine field names and mixed-seat histories.
scope.markTiming: The adapter records observed phase order but does not resolve the known event-night difference between human-after-reveal and AI-before-reveal marking.
deferred: Independent proof that every accepted observation is generated by the pinned projection function
Public reveal and automatic transition records between player decisions
Complete chance support and full-game branch probabilities
Terminal payoff utility, policy enumeration and solver review

fixtures.proves: A single-seat ordered history can include each currently adapted event, mark, sacrifice, auction and shrine-pick observation/action schema; the key is stable and sensitive to history contents.
fixtures.doesNotProve: That projections are exhaustively complete, generated only by pinned code, or include every intervening public transition.

fixtures.proves: Mixed-seat records, mismatched phase schemas, illegal choices, and known raw engine-state fields are rejected.
fixtures.doesNotProve: Server-grade secrecy, all possible hidden-field aliases, or comprehensive information-set equivalence.

fixtures.proves: Observations produced by the pinned event, mark, sacrifice, auction and shrine-pick adapters can be appended in one same-seat sequence across rounds.
fixtures.doesNotProve: That callers cannot fabricate a frozen object with an accepted schema, or that every intervening public transition is retained.

nextEngineeringDeliverable.name: projection provenance, public transition history and cross-night restore
requirements: Bind accepted observation objects to the adapter projection functions and carry sanitized public transitions between decisions.
Prove complete random branch support and conditional probabilities through automatic battle, settlement and cross-night market/event scheduling.
Restore canonical cross-night snapshots with matching gameplay and UI RNG streams, including history and private destiny state.
Measure the event-night mark timing difference on paired seeds with predeclared player-impact measures.
Specify terminal utility and feasible policy/solver scope before any pass claim.

gate.blockingReason: The full-recall envelope only wraps selected adapter schemas. Projection provenance, public transition history, full chance, cross-night restoration, canonicalization, terminal payoff, policy enumeration and independent solver review remain incomplete.
